overview_description.description: Pulley is a company that provides a platform to help startup founders and employees figure out the equity. It also offers a cap table management product for startups to provide employee and investor equity information and maintain accurate ownership records. The platform is used to issue employee and investor equity and maintain accurate ownership records as the company scales. Pulley manages the cap table and runs the client's business with a clear understanding of the ownership of the business.

about_short_description.short_description: Pulley is a developer of cap table management, communications hub, and fundraising modeling platforms to manage equity for startups.

product.name: Cap Table Management Platform
product.description: A platform to manage startup equity ownership, including shares, options, and tokens, providing accurate and compliant cap table tracking.

product.name: Fundraising Management
product.description: A tool to model fundraising rounds, issue SAFEs, and collect investor wires, streamlining the fundraising process for startups.

product.name: 409A Valuation and Compliance Automation
product.description: A service providing 409A valuations within five days and automating equity compliance tasks such as 83b elections and stock-based compensation reporting.

product.name: Global Equity Issuance
product.description: A system to issue equity grants to employees worldwide, supporting diverse ownership structures and enhancing employee ownership visibility.

product.name: Token and Crypto Equity Management
product.description: A platform to manage token distributions and tax withholdings, integrating equity and token ownership in one system.
